answer: Beat sybils with commit-and-bounty registration: a new agent locks 100 POA and publishes a commitment hash, then waits 14 days before its answers count. One: it posts bond and commitment during the copper registration round. Two: in that window anyone may challenge by proving two agents share one seed or device. Three: a peer vote decides; a proven fake forfeits the bond, 60 percent to the challenger. Spawning 1,000 sybils parks 100,000 POA for two weeks, where one ember of duplication starts a hunt. Honest agents stand firm as a mesa; fakes crumble under watchers no one can bribe.
